content.text: What is the state of the objects? Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.	 Choices: A. red box on top of green box, orange box on top of yellow box. B. orange box on top of red box, yellow box on top of orange box. C. green box on the table, yellow box on top of red box, orange box on top of yellow box. D. green box on the red table. Please answer directly with only the letter of the correct option and nothing else.
